choices.label: Languages
choices.hint: Every character knows Common plus two standard languages.

classes.name: Fighter
classes.description: A master of martial combat, skilled with a variety of weapons and armor.

traits.name: Second Wind
traits.text: Bonus Action: regain 1d10 + Fighter level HP. 2 uses; regain one on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest.

traits.name: Weapon Mastery
traits.text: Use the mastery properties of three kinds of Simple or Martial weapons. After a Long Rest you can swap one choice.

traits.name: Fighting Style
traits.text: Gain a Fighting Style feat. Whenever you gain a Fighter level you can replace it.

choices.label: Weapon Mastery
choices.hint: Pick weapons you will actually carry — check your starting equipment.

options.name: Heavy (Chain Mail)
options.description: Chain Mail, Greatsword, Flail, 8 Javelins, Dungeoneer's Pack, 4 GP

options.name: Light (Studded Leather)
options.description: Studded Leather Armor, Scimitar, Shortsword, Longbow, 20 Arrows, Quiver, Dungeoneer's Pack, 11 GP

options.name: Gold
options.description: 155 GP to buy your own gear (shopping is not automated yet)

species.name: Dragonborn
species.description: Descendants of dragons, with a breath weapon and resistance tied to their ancestor.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.text: Replace one attack of the Attack action with a 15-ft Cone or 30-ft Line (5 ft wide). Dex save (DC 8 + Con mod + PB), 1d10 damage of your ancestry's type, half on success. Uses = Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.text: Resistance to the damage type of your Draconic Ancestry.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: 60 feet.

traits.name: Draconic Flight (level 5)
traits.text: Bonus Action to gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed for 10 minutes, once per Long Rest.

species.name: Dwarf
species.description: Hardy folk of stone and forge; tough, poison-resistant, with long darkvision.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: 120 feet.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.text: Resistance to Poison damage; Advantage on saves to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.text: Hit Point maximum +1, and +1 again whenever you gain a level.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.text: Bonus Action: Tremorsense 60 ft for 10 minutes while on or touching stone. Uses = Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

species.name: Elf
species.description: Long-lived fey-touched people who trance instead of sleeping.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: 60 feet.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.text: Advantage on saves to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.text: Proficiency in Insight, Perception, or Survival.

traits.name: Trance
traits.text: You don't need to sleep; a Long Rest takes 4 hours of trancelike meditation.

options.name: Drow
options.description: Darkvision 120 ft; Dancing Lights cantrip. Faerie Fire (lvl 3), Darkness (lvl 5).

options.name: High Elf
options.description: Prestidigitation cantrip (swappable for any Wizard cantrip on a Long Rest). Detect Magic (lvl 3), Misty Step (lvl 5).

options.name: Wood Elf
options.description: Speed 35 ft; Druidcraft cantrip. Longstrider (lvl 3), Pass without Trace (lvl 5).

species.name: Gnome
species.description: Small, clever tinkerers and illusionists with a knack for resisting magic.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: 60 feet.

traits.name: Gnomish Cunning
traits.text: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

options.name: Forest Gnome
options.description: Minor Illusion cantrip; Speak with Animals always prepared, castable without a slot PB times per Long Rest.

options.name: Rock Gnome
options.description: Mending and Prestidigitation cantrips; can craft Tiny clockwork devices with Prestidigitation.

species.name: Goliath
species.description: Towering descendants of giants, with a supernatural boon from their ancestry.

traits.name: Large Form (level 5)
traits.text: Bonus Action to become Large for 10 minutes, once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.text: Advantage on checks to end the Grappled condition; count as one size larger for carrying capacity.

choices.label: Giant Ancestry (uses = Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest)

options.name: Cloud's Jaunt
options.description: Bonus Action to teleport up to 30 ft to an unoccupied space you can see.

options.name: Fire's Burn
options.description: When you hit with an attack roll and deal damage, deal an extra 1d10 Fire.

options.name: Frost's Chill
options.description: On a hit that deals damage, deal an extra 1d6 Cold and reduce Speed by 10 ft.

options.name: Hill's Tumble
options.description: On a hit that deals damage to a Large or smaller creature, knock it Prone.

options.name: Stone's Endurance
options.description: Reaction when you take damage; reduce it by 1d12 + Con mod.

options.name: Storm's Thunder
options.description: Reaction when damaged by a creature within 60 ft; deal 1d8 Thunder to it.

traits.name: Brave
traits.text: Advantage on saves to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.text: Move through the space of any creature a size larger than you.

traits.name: Luck
traits.text: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, reroll it and use the new roll.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.text: You can Hide when obscured only by a creature at least one size larger than you.

species.name: Human
species.description: Adaptable and ambitious; an extra skill and an extra Origin feat.

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.text: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.text: Proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.text: An Origin feat of your choice (Skilled is recommended).

species.name: Orc
species.description: Relentless, enduring warriors who surge forward in battle.

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
traits.text: Dash as a Bonus Action and gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Uses = Proficiency Bonus per Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: 120 feet.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.text: When reduced to 0 HP but not killed outright, drop to 1 HP instead. Once per Long Rest.

species.name: Tiefling
species.description: Bearers of a fiendish legacy that grants resistance and innate magic.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: 60 feet.

traits.name: Otherworldly Presence
traits.text: You know Thaumaturgy, using your Fiendish Legacy spellcasting ability.

options.name: Abyssal
options.description: Resistance to Poison; Poison Spray cantrip. Ray of Sickness (lvl 3), Hold Person (lvl 5).

options.name: Chthonic
options.description: Resistance to Necrotic; Chill Touch cantrip. False Life (lvl 3), Ray of Enfeeblement (lvl 5).

options.name: Infernal
options.description: Resistance to Fire; Fire Bolt cantrip. Hellish Rebuke (lvl 3), Darkness (lvl 5).

backgrounds.name: Acolyte
backgrounds.description: You devoted yourself to service in a temple.

options.name: Package
options.description: Calligrapher's Supplies, Book (prayers), Holy Symbol, Parchment (10), Robe, 8 GP

options.name: Gold
options.description: 50 GP

backgrounds.name: Criminal
backgrounds.description: You scraped by in dark alleys as a cutpurse or burglar.

options.name: Package
options.description: 2 Daggers, Thieves' Tools, Crowbar, 2 Pouches, Traveler's Clothes, 16 GP

options.name: Gold
options.description: 50 GP

backgrounds.name: Sage
backgrounds.description: You spent formative years in libraries, studying lore.

options.name: Package
options.description: Quarterstaff, Calligrapher's Supplies, Book (history), Parchment (8), Robe, 8 GP

options.name: Gold
options.description: 50 GP

backgrounds.name: Soldier
backgrounds.description: You trained for war from a young age.

options.name: Package
options.description: Spear, Shortbow, 20 Arrows, Gaming Set (same as your tool), Healer's Kit, Quiver, Traveler's Clothes, 14 GP

options.name: Gold
options.description: 50 GP

feats.name: Alert
feats.description: Initiative Proficiency: add your Proficiency Bonus to Initiative. Initiative Swap: after rolling Initiative, swap it with a willing ally's (neither can be Incapacitated).

feats.name: Magic Initiate
feats.description: Learn two cantrips and one level 1 spell from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard list. You can cast the level 1 spell once per Long Rest without a slot. Repeatable with a different list.
feats.unsupported: Cantrip and level 1 spell selection is not automated yet — note them by hand.

feats.name: Savage Attacker
feats.description: Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll.

feats.name: Skilled
feats.description: Gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.

feats.name: Archery
feats.description: +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with Ranged weapons.

feats.name: Defense
feats.description: While wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor, +1 bonus to Armor Class.

feats.name: Great Weapon Fighting
feats.description: When you roll damage for a Melee attack with a weapon held in two hands (Two-Handed or Versatile), treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3.

feats.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
feats.description: When you make the extra attack from the Light property, add your ability modifier to its damage if you aren't already.

gear.name: Dungeoneer's Pack
gear.description: Backpack, Caltrops, Crowbar, 2 flasks of Oil, 10 days of Rations, Rope, Tinderbox, 10 Torches, and Waterskin.

gear.name: Gaming Set (same as your tool proficiency)

masteries.name: Cleave
masteries.description: On a melee hit, attack a second creature within 5 ft of the first (no ability modifier to damage). Once per turn.

masteries.name: Graze
masteries.description: On a miss, deal damage equal to the ability modifier used for the attack.

masteries.name: Nick
masteries.description: Make the Light property's extra attack as part of the Attack action instead of a Bonus Action. Once per turn.

masteries.name: Push
masteries.description: On a hit, push a Large or smaller creature up to 10 ft straight away from you.

masteries.name: Sap
masteries.description: On a hit, the creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before your next turn.

masteries.name: Slow
masteries.description: On a hit that deals damage, reduce the creature's Speed by 10 ft until your next turn.

masteries.name: Topple
masteries.description: On a hit, the creature makes a Con save (DC 8 + ability mod + PB) or falls Prone.

masteries.name: Vex
masteries.description: On a hit that deals damage, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against it before the end of your next turn.
